subject: Public Hearing, 1049 Lowell, Lots 2-3, Lot Line Change, Planning Commission 3/10/21-
comment: I will make every effort to attend the zoom meeting tomorrow night. I just arrived in town and was surprised to see the tepee is still there….years later. What actions are being taken by the City to enforce the ordinance at this point? The owner is obviously making no effort to conform to the 180 day rule. I also must mention that no notice was given to the Northstar Homeowners Association regarding the lot line change. The Association also has contiguous property to lots 2 and 3. The Association owns Northstar Drive. Mr. Larcher is no longer a member of this association and has not been for years. My understanding was Mr Larcher gave up the right to use Northstar Drive when he left the association and terminated paying his annual dues years ago. Best regards, Mike Grimme
source: Agenda packet correspondence (forwarded resident email / eComment-form submission; published in CivicClerk agenda packet)
